sources.note: OeAD-GmbH FAQ for the Ernst Mach Grant worldwide, explicitly for the current call (Austrian academic year 2027/28); contains the eligibility rules and the exact deadline.
OeAD-GmbH programme page for the Ernst Mach Grant; the 'Ernst Mach Grant - worldwide' section states target group, duration, age limit and closing date.
OeAD-GmbH scholarships and funding programmes A to Z listing; cross-checks target group, duration, funding organisation and closing date for the worldwide grant.
The record's recorded official_source_url (grants.at deep link). It now resolves to the generic grants.at database homepage with no programme-specific content, so it fails to show the grant details.

awarding_body.detail: The pages read are on oead.at, the awarding body's own domain, and name OeAD-GmbH as the funding organisation on behalf of the Austrian Federal Ministry of Women, Science and Research (BMFWF).
awarding_body.quote: Funding organisation: OeAD-GmbH on behalf and financed by the Austrian Federal Ministry of Women, Science and Research

deadline.detail: The current cycle (Austrian academic year 2027/28) is open now: online applications run from September and close 1 December 2026, 23:59 CET. This matches the record's deadline date of 2026-12-01 and the record's wording is itself an exact quote of the FAQ.
deadline.quote: The application deadline for this grant is December 1st, 2026, 23:59 (CET - Central European Time) for all applications for stays during the academic year 2027/28.

eligibility.detail: All eligibility claims in the record were confirmed: young researchers from countries other than Austria; age 35 or under at the start of the stay; doctoral/PhD candidates enrolled outside Austria or postdocs who finished their studies abroad after 30 September 2025; and a written supervision confirmation from an Austrian university lecturer is required. Austrian-resident/enrolled applicants are excluded.
eligibility.quote: Postgraduates pursuing a doctoral/PhD programme outside Austria; Postgraduates and post-docs who want to do research in Austria with a view to an academic career and who have finished their studies (at a university outside Austria) after September 30th, 2025; Post-docs who are working as lecturers or researchers at a university outside Austria. Applicants must not be older than 35 years when they start their research stay.

funding.detail: The grant is partially funded, not fully funded: the OeAD states the scholarship may not cover all expenses, that grant rates assume Austrian living costs exceed the grant, and that own funds are required. The exact monthly rate is not stated on the pages read (the Ukraine variant on the same page lists 715 euros/month; the worldwide rate is not published there).
funding.quote: The scholarship may not cover all expenses for your research stay in Austria. ... Our grant rates are based on the assumption that actual living costs in Austria are higher than the grant itself. Hence own funds are required.

degree_levels.detail: The programme targets doctoral and postdoctoral researchers (A-Z listing: 'Target group: Postgraduates, Postdocs'; 1 to 9 months). Strictly, it awards no degree: it funds a research stay only and explicitly cannot be used to enrol in a Master or PhD programme in Austria. The record's 'PhD, Postdoctoral' describes the target group, which matches the official listing.
degree_levels.quote: The Ernst Mach Grant worldwide is targeted at young researchers from all disciplines and countries (except Austria) who wish to pursue a research project in Austria. ... No. The Ernst Mach grant is not intended to finance a complete or parts of a regular PhD, Master or study programme in Austria.

recommended_field_updates.deadline_text: The application deadline for this grant is December 1st, 2026, 23:59 (CET - Central European Time) for all applications for stays during the academic year 2027/28. Online application is possible from September to December 1st.
recommended_field_updates.verification_notes: Call for the Austrian academic year 2027/28 is open (applications September 2026 to 1 December 2026, 23:59 CET); results expected at the beginning of July 2027. Grant funds a 1-9 month research stay in Austria only - no degree enrolment. Own funds are required (partial funding). Monthly grant rate is not stated on the OeAD pages; check the grant regulations (Sonderrichtlinie Incoming PDF) or the application portal for the current rate. The recorded grants.at deep link no longer resolves to the programme entry - use the OeAD programme page and the worldwide FAQ page above.

notes_for_reviewer: All checked claims agree with the awarding body's own pages, and the 1 December 2026 deadline is for the cycle open today. Two caveats for the catalogue card: (1) degree_levels 'PhD, Postdoctoral' describes the target group, not an awarded degree - the grant explicitly cannot be used to enrol in a Master or PhD programme in Austria; (2) the record's official_source_url (grants.at deep link) now redirects to the generic grants.at database homepage, so the URL should be replaced with the OeAD programme page.
